name: csearch
description: Search the kickoff catalog files (filelist/timeline/bodyfile/pslist/cmdline/netscan/malfind/dlllist/psscan) for one or more patterns and return matching lines prefixed with the source file. Used for citation verification.

patterns.description: List of substrings/regexes to search for

files.description: Catalog files to search, subset of filelist,timeline,bodyfile,pslist,psscan,cmdline,netscan,malfind,dlllist (default filelist,timeline)

catalog_root.description: Directory of catalog text files; when set, keys resolve to <catalog_root>/<basename> instead of the baked s4a-challenge4 paths
